proposals.evidence: DEDR 4879 full article: Ka. mīse id. Koḍ. mi·se id. Tu. mīsè moustaches, whiskers; feelers of an insect. Te. mīsamu ( pl. mīsamulu, mīsalu) moustache, whiskers. Kol. mi·sal ( pl. ) moustache. Nk. (Ch.) mīsak id. Go. (M.) mīsāṅg ,… The article gives Kannada mīse “moustache”; Census mīca is the same hair noun in source notation.
